descriptions.text: Drakea's Enchanted Kerchief of Disorder. This handy-dandy, versatile garment can be worn around the neck, in the hair, or on your face if you want to cosplay as a cowboy robbing a bank. Can also be tied around your arms or legs, but only if you want to look like a moron. Don't tie it around your leg. This simple, square piece of fabric is a reminder that looks can be deceiving. The wearer of this item receives the following benefits: +5 to the Detect Traps skill. Wearer may cast a level-15 Tripper spell once every five hours. The Remote Detonator benefit.

beats.headline: A name from the cookbook
beats.text: The gold boss box peels open like a banana on a black bandana with a white paisley pattern, like the one Carl wore at work against the stench of the docks. The name makes his pulse quicken: Drakea's Enchanted Kerchief of Disorder. Tripper at level fifteen sets off every trap in a wide radius, though it does not disarm them. The real prize is Remote Detonator, which sets off any explosive Carl has designated. He ties it round his head, and Donut does not like the vibe. Mordecai remembers Drakea, a famous crawler with a class like Carl's, partly responsible for what happened to the nagas.

beats.headline: The first remote detonation
beats.text: Donut shrieks with joy at the gun, and a double-shot magic missile slams into a growing plume of pulsing rainbow smoke. Carl loads a fused hob-lobber, designates it with his new remote detonator skill and throws it. Even able to throw twice as far now, he has waited a hair too long, so he sets it off just as the ball starts to dip, twenty feet short of the plume. That is plenty close. The crackling circle of rainbow smoke plummets out of the sky, and its sticky disco-ball remnants follow Quan Ch down like a comet.

beats.headline: Every trap at once
beats.text: Carl sets a launcher box of twenty-five surefire missiles against a hedge and marks its timed trigger with Remote Detonator, then marks a bomb with a second one. One mental click on the first trigger in his hotlist, and the rockets corkscrew into the air one by one. Then, on the run, he steps on two traps at once: a cheap spike trap and an alarm that starts blasting Kickstart My Heart. He casts Tripper, and every trap in a wide radius goes off around them, songs and small explosions. He pulls the alarm into his inventory to shut it up.

beats.headline: Tripper on loan to Imani
beats.text: Elle reports that they are inside the stronghold, searching for traps, and a searing pain hits Carl's chest. Crawler Imani C has used your Tripper spell. Lots of traps just went off. The plan had been to lend her or Elle the bandana, but neither can wear it: fairy-class and other magical races are extremely limited in the magical gear they can wear. Taking it off, Carl learned his own Tripper had risen to level seven by itself. He could not give Imani the item, but she could borrow the spell as a tattoo, and when Katia drew the blood he lost six levels of it. That does not matter: the bandana brings it to fifteen either way.
